report_text:
WEEKLY FEEDBACK REPORT  |  14 Sep to 20 Sep 2026
Total reviews: 210   Positive 45%   Neutral 12%   Negative 43%

TOP 3 COMPLAINTS
  1. Extra charges on bill .... 21 reviews  (mostly Swiggy, Amazon and Google; English, Tamil, Tanglish; steady across the week)
  2. Late delivery ............ 20 reviews  (mostly Swiggy and Amazon; evenings and Friday nights; English and Tanglish)
  3. Small portion size ....... 11 reviews  (across Amazon, Swiggy, Zomato and Google; English, Tamil, Tanglish; mostly medium urgency)

TOP PRAISE
  Tasty biryani and overall food quality (43 mentions), Neat, leak-proof packaging (22 mentions), Friendly and courteous staff (11 mentions)

URGENT: 27 reviews need a reply within 24 hours

ACTION ITEMS
  1. Audit all menu, add-on and packing/service charge displays this week, then standardise bill screens and receipts so customers see the full price before paying.
  2. Tighten delivery handoff for late-evening and Friday orders by adding dispatch cut-offs, rider escalation for delays, and immediate customer updates when ETAs slip.
  3. Review portion controls for biryani and combo meals, especially on Swiggy and Amazon orders, and set a kitchen check so small-portion complaints are caught before dispatch.
